T: The exhibits wake up hungry after dark.
D: A new night guard at a natural history museum finds the exhibits come alive after closing.
P: Serve the mains when the T. rex skeleton wants to play fetch.
S: Roman legion warm olives and focaccia
Octavius and his tiny Roman army

Mixed olives warmed in olive oil with lemon peel, garlic, oregano and chilli, with torn rosemary focaccia for dipping in the oil and balsamic. Warm 300g mixed olives in a small pan with 80ml olive oil, 3 strips lemon peel, 2 sliced garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano and a pinch of chilli flakes over low heat for 8 minutes. Warm a 400g rosemary focaccia at 180C for 6 minutes and tear into pieces. Serve the olives in their oil, with a small dish of balsamic for dipping.
Knotted garlic parmesan breadsticks shaped like bones, tomato dipping sauce
Pizza dough rolled into ropes, knotted at both ends into bone shapes, brushed with garlic butter and parmesan, baked at 220C for 12 minutes. Marinara dip.
Gum gum watermelon, feta and mint skewers
Chilled watermelon and feta cubes threaded with mint on short skewers

Icy watermelon cubes skewered with salty feta and mint, finished with lime juice, a drizzle of honey and a pinch of flaky salt and chilli. Cut a quarter of a watermelon and 200g feta into 2cm cubes. Thread onto short skewers with a mint leaf between each. Lay on a platter and chill for 30 minutes. Just before serving, squeeze over the juice of a lime, drizzle with 1 tbsp honey and add a pinch of flaky salt and chilli flakes.
M: Franks in steamed buns with onion tomato sauce, spicy mustard, warm sauerkraut
Franks simmered in water with onions, in steamed buns with spicy brown mustard, sauerkraut and onions in a tomato sauce.
Jedediah, the tiny cowboy in the diorama

Mini beef patties glazed with smoky barbecue sauce, melted cheddar, pickles and crispy fried onions on soft slider buns, with a crunchy apple slaw. Shape 700g beef mince into 12 small patties and season. Grill on a hot plate 2 minutes a side, brushing with 80ml barbecue sauce, and top with cheddar to melt. Toss half a shredded cabbage and a julienned green apple with 3 tbsp mayo and lemon juice. Fill 12 toasted slider buns with patties, pickles and a handful of fried shallots. Serve the slaw alongside.
W: Thick sliced banana bread, toasted and buttered
Ripe bananas mashed with melted butter, brown sugar and eggs, flour and bicarb folded in, baked at 170C for an hour, sliced and toasted with butter.
K: Hot chocolate with dark chocolate, cocoa and cinnamon, kept hot in a thermos

Rich hot chocolate made with melted dark chocolate, cocoa and a little cinnamon, poured into a thermos and topped with marshmallows at the cup. Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 100g chopped dark chocolate, 2 tbsp cocoa, 2 tbsp brown sugar and a pinch of cinnamon until smooth. Pour into a warmed thermos to keep hot through the movie. Serve in mugs topped with marshmallows.

s.note: Knotted garlic parmesan breadsticks shaped like bones, tomato dipping sauce
s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough into 12 ropes and knot both ends into bone shapes. Brush with 50g butter melted with 2 garlic cloves and sprinkle with 40g parmesan. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Simmer a tin of crushed tomatoes 10 minutes to dip.

s.n: Gum gum watermelon, feta and mint skewers
s.note: Chilled watermelon and feta cubes threaded with mint on short skewers
s.how: Cut a quarter of a watermelon and 200g feta into 2cm cubes. Thread onto short skewers with a mint leaf between each. Lay on a platter and chill for 30 minutes. Just before serving, squeeze over the juice of a lime, drizzle with 1 tbsp honey and add a pinch of flaky salt and chilli flakes.

m.note: Franks in steamed buns with onion tomato sauce, spicy mustard, warm sauerkraut
m.how: Soften 2 sliced onions in oil for 15 minutes, add 2 tbsp tomato paste and a splash of water and cook down. Simmer 8 franks in water for 5 minutes. Put in steamed buns with spicy mustard, warm sauerkraut and the onions.

w.note: Thick sliced banana bread, toasted and buttered
w.how: Mash 3 ripe bananas with 100g melted butter, 150g brown sugar and 2 eggs. Fold in 250g flour and 1 tsp bicarb. Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for an hour. Cool, slice thick, toast and spread with butter.
